about: Everything on storm-charles.promptugal.news, catalogued: every brief, plan, decision log, dataset, tool, agent file and research file, with what it is (its own first words), who wrote it, when it last changed, what it was made from and what links to it. Built from the repository by tools/library-index.mjs; nothing is guessed: what a file does not say is empty here and listed under gaps. The data files' own catalogue (with the served sha256) is api/v1/index.json.

kind.rules: The rules every agent reads first.
kind.brief: Dinis's direction, close to his words, and its corrections.
kind.plan: Proposals and priorities: what is to be built and in what order.
kind.decision log: The timeline of signals and the decisions, newest first.
kind.incident record: The incident's own page and front-page record.
kind.dataset: JSON data: every value with its source and the time read.
kind.dataset doc: What a dataset holds and who keeps it.
kind.analysis: Our analysis, labelled as analysis: a hypothesis with its reasons, never a fact.
kind.research: Research files: what was found, where, and when it was read.
kind.reading: The reading list: what others wrote that bears on this site, and what it means here.
kind.library: The catalogue itself, the glossary, the standard.
kind.agent file: Each agent's jobs, status and asks.
kind.comms draft: Drafts for people; a person sends.
kind.material: Material offered to another newsroom's desk.
kind.build: The build, the gate and CI.

fields.by: who the file itself says wrote or keeps it (by_from says where: header, front matter, its own fields); empty when it does not say
fields.dated: the time the file gives for itself (dated_from says which field or the header); for a dataset, usually the time its sources were last read
fields.commits: from the commits, as recorded in library/provenance.json (first_by, last_by, last_at, the agents); null when the file changed after the commits were last read
fields.changed: when it last changed: the last commit when known, else the file's own date
fields.made_from: the sources its header or fields name: files here (paths) and URLs
fields.links_to: files here that it links to anywhere in its text
fields.linked_from: files here that link to it or name it as a source
fields.sha256: of the file in the repository at this build (generated files carry none)
